issue.title: Test 4x long-context skew at qk=1.75
issue.body:
## TL;DR

Launch a production-priority v4-2048 treatment twin of the qk=1.75 262K context-extension run. Preserve the checkpoint, optimizer, schedule, mesh, batch size, data offset, and quality-by-domain weights while sampling >64K documents at four times their proportional rate.

## Description

The control extends the step-156000 cooldown checkpoint from 65K to 262K context for 1000 steps at batch size 256. The treatment uses the length-partitioned Datakit store from #8656. The completed 2x treatment is tracked in #8734.

## Hypothesis or Goal

Measure how a 4x long-document sampling skew changes Paloma macro loss and training behavior relative to the qk=1.75 control and 2x treatment.

## Status

Running on 256 non-preemptible v4 workers with production priority. The workers are loading the step-156000 checkpoint.
